description: Add visible validation and accessible error handling to the run launch form when required project data is missing.

planSpec.content: Add inline validation to the project selector, keep the existing launch API unchanged, and verify the Runs page through browser checks.

spec:
1. Show an inline validation state when Launch is attempted without a selected project.
2. Preserve the existing run launch endpoint and request shape.
3. Verify keyboard, dark mode, and mobile behavior on the Runs page.

textFilePaths.content:
# Manual Verification

1. Open /runs.
2. Try to launch without a project.
3. Confirm inline validation appears.

title: Run Launch Validation
